verdict.rationale: Atlas's own docs say it issues founder equity, files 83(b) elections for all C-corp founders, and lets founders customize vesting period, cliff and start date. Its company-setup paperwork comes from templates built with Cooley LLP and is viewable in the Atlas Dashboard Documents tab. That covers the core of the post-incorporation setup this story describes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of IP assignment agreements, explicit mention of founder stock purchase agreements (only 'issues founders equity'), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the founder-equity and 83(b) paperwork is correct.
